title: Gajar ka Halwa (Carrot Pudding)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A much-loved carrot pudding across Pakistan and India, from the author's young friend Syeda Rabab Jafar.

steps.action: Bring just to a boil in a large pot on high:
items: 1¾ lb carrots (800 g), peeled and grated

steps.action: Reduce to medium (5/10); cook, stirring, 30+ min, until the milk is mostly gone.
Add and cook until the milk is fully dried up and the carrots darken:
Add and cook 3 min, stirring often:
Transfer to a serving dish; garnish (optional, recommended):
items: ¼ cup slivered almonds and pistachios (60 ml)
1 cup heavy cream (240 ml), lightly whisked 2 min
